result.instructions: Tools for Quarterwise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my rental properties and businesses in Quarterwise."; "Show all expenses of my Brookfield Road property since 6 April."; "Which HMRC category keys can I use for an overseas property?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quarterwise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quarterwise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quarterwise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quarterwise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quarterwise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quarterwise_get_account
tools.title: Get account and API capabilities
tools.description: Show which Quarterwise account the key belongs to, its plan (free, pro, expat, firm) and what the API can do. HMRC submission is always false: filing is done in the app. API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_sources
tools.title: List properties and businesses
tools.description: List the income sources on the account: UK properties, overseas properties and self-employment businesses, with id, type, share percent, role (owner or sharer) and transaction count. The id is the input of the transaction tools. API: GET /api/v1/sources.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_categories
tools.title: List HMRC category keys
tools.description: List the valid income and expense category keys (HMRC field names) per source type. Keys differ by type, so check them before adding transactions. API: GET /api/v1/categories.

source_type.description: Limit the result to one source type. Omit for all three.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions of a source
tools.description: List income and expense entries of one property or business, optionally in a date range. Amounts are in pence. Returns nextCursor: pass it as cursor to get the next page. API: GET /api/v1/sources/{id}/transactions.

tools.name: quarterwise_add_transactions
tools.title: Add transactions to a source (write)
tools.description: WRITE: add 1 to 100 income or expense entries to a property or business ledger. Each entry needs a unique externalRef: re-posting the same ref adds nothing, so a retry is safe. Entries without a category go to the review queue in the app. Never submits anything to HMRC. API: POST /api/v1/sources/{id}/transactions.

category.description: HMRC category key valid for the source type (from quarterwise_list_categories). Omit to send the entry to the review queue.

externalRef.description: Your own unique id for this entry. Posting the same ref again returns the existing entry, so a retry never double-counts.
